paragraphs.text: Works gallery for DeepSeek Harness
# dsh-works-gallery 作品库
**English** · 中文

A right-sidebar tab for DeepSeek Harness that shows
**every image and video made in your workspaces*

*, newest first, as a thumbnail wall. No more
scrolling back through old chats to find the poster yo
u generated last week.
## What it does

- **Scans, does not index.** Walks the workspace roots on request (10 s cache) and lists every
`.png

.jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .avif .bmp .svg .mp4 .webm .mov .m4v .mkv` file it finds.
- **Newest first, g

rouped by day** — `Today`, `Yesterday`, then plain dates.
- **Thumbnail wall** — images lazy-load, v

ideos show a muted first frame with a play badge.
- **Click to open** a full-screen lightbox: images

at full size, videos with controls and seeking
(the file route speaks `Range`, so scrubbing works).

- **Filters** — All / Images / Videos, plus a file-name search across path and name.
- **Show in fo

lder** and **copy path** straight from the lightbox.
- **Tidy up without fear.** Hit **Select**, tic

k any number of thumbnails, and **Delete** moves them
to the OS recycle bin — one click restores the

m from there. Non-media files, and anything outside
the roots, is refused by the host.
- **Read-only

by default.** Only the delete route touches the disk, and only for the files you
ticked that live u

** Only the delete route touches the disk, and only for the files you
ticked that live under a root.
## Where the files come from
By default it scans the directory DSH keeps its workspaces in:
| OS | Default root |

| Windows | `%USERPROFILE%\Documents\deepseek-harness` |
| macOS / Linux | `~/Documents/deepseek-har

ws | `%USERPROFILE%\Documents\deepseek-harness` |
| macOS / Linux | `~/Documents/deepseek-harness` |

If that directory does not exist it falls back to `~/Documents`. Override with
`DSH_WORKS_GALLERY_RO
OTS` — several roots separated by `;` on Windows and `:` elsewhere:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Every `/file` and `/api/reveal` request is checked against those roots **after resolving symlinks**,
so a link inside a root cannot be used to read something outside it. Only media extensions are serv
a link inside a root cannot be used to read something outside it. Only media extensions are served.
## Install
From the DSH plugin market: search **作品库 / works gallery** and install, then restart DSH.

Manually: copy this repository into your profile's `node_modules`, and add the package name to
`dsh.
profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The Host half's routes are hot-applied on the next bundle-list reload; the sidebar tab appears
after
a page refresh (or a DSH restart).
## Open it

Right sidebar → **Guidance / 引导** tab → the **Gallery / 作品库** capsule. In the right sidebar's
tab ba
r it stays available as its own tab afterwards.
## HTTP routes
All under `/dsh-works-gallery`. Only the last one touches the disk:
| Route | Purpose |
| `GET /api/list` | `{ ok, roots, total, truncated, items[] }`, newest first, capped at 5000 entries

/ depth 8 |
| `GET /file?path=…` | Streams one media file; supports `Range` (206) so video seeking

works |
| `GET /api/reveal?path=…` | Reveals the file in Explorer / Finder / the desktop file manage

r |
| `POST /api/delete` | `{ paths: [...] }` (max 300) → moves each file to the OS recycle bin. Ret
urns `{ ok, deleted[], failed[{path,error}] }`; paths outside the roots, or without a media extensio
ted[], failed[{path,error}] }`; paths outside the roots, or without a media extension, are refused |
Skipped while scanning: `node_modules`, `.git`, `.cache`, `dist`, `venv`, `__pycache__`, dot-directo

ries
and other dependency/build folders.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the right sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`)
- Node.js >=

DeepSeek Harness with the right sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`)
